WITH SRC AS
(
SELECT DISTINCT 
	CLT_CIF_NUMBER
    ,BNK_CODE
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,insert_dttm
 FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT
),
TGT AS
(
SELECT DISTINCT
	CLT_CIF_NUMBER
    ,BANK_CODE
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,insert_dttm
FROM SYN.STG_ATM_CLIENT
)

SELECT count(1)
FROM SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TGT
	ON SRC.CLT_CIF_NUMBER = TGT.CLT_CIF_NUMBER
    AND SRC.BNK_CODE =  TGT.BANK_CODE
	AND SRC.SOURCE_CODE =  TGT.SOURCE_CODE
	AND SRC.FILE_NAME =  TGT.FILE_NAME
	AND SRC.insert_dttm =  TGT.insert_dttm

WHERE (
	SRC. CLT_CIF_NUMBER IS NULL OR TGT.CLT_CIF_NUMBER IS NULL
    OR SRC.BNK_CODE IS NULL OR TGT.BANK_CODE IS NULL
	OR SRC.SOURCE_CODE IS NULL OR TGT.SOURCE_CODE IS NULL
	OR SRC.FILE_NAME IS NULL OR TGT.FILE_NAME IS NULL
	OR SRC.insert_dttm IS NULL OR TGT.insert_dttm IS NULL
)
